candidates.name: GetProcessMemoryInfo
verified_facts: Returns or defines process memory accounting values such as working-set, page-fault, private, commit, or peak counters for a process snapshot.
semantic_limits: Memory counters are volatile, may use different accounting definitions, and do not prove process identity, task ownership, progress, or receipt production.

candidates.name: QueryWorkingSet
verified_facts: Returns or defines resident working-set page information and per-address attributes for a process.
semantic_limits: Working-set membership changes continuously; enumeration can race paging activity and does not establish mapped-file bytes, module identity, or task success.

candidates.name: EmptyWorkingSet
verified_facts: Documents a working-set trimming operation and its required process access.
semantic_limits: Documentation-only safety reference: the operation was not executed because trimming a live runner can change performance and evidence state.

semantic_limits: A virtual-memory region snapshot can change immediately and does not by itself identify the backing file, module version, authorized producer, or receipt.

candidates.name: GetMappedFileNameW
verified_facts: Returns module handles, paths, base names, mapped-file names, image paths, ranges, or exported-symbol addresses for process image correlation.
semantic_limits: Module lists and loader state can change during inspection; paths and handles must be joined to process creation time, file identity, byte hash, architecture, and exact observation time.
